name: Stack Usage Estimator
blurb: worst-case stack from call depth and locals
intro: Finds the deepest path through your call graph (each function's frame, including saved registers and locals, as GCC's -fstack-usage reports it), adds one exception frame and the deepest handler for every interrupt preemption level that can nest, and a safety margin. Frames can be typed in or pasted from .su files; recursion and missing frames are reported because they make the estimate too low.

inputs.label: Architecture
options: Cortex-M, no FPU (36 B per interrupt)
RISC-V (0 B, saved in the prologue)

inputs.label: Entry function
inputs.help: main, or a task function for an RTOS task stack.

inputs.label: Functions
inputs.help: Frame in bytes (blank = take it from the .su data); calls separated by spaces or commas.

inputs.label: .su data (optional)
inputs.default:
stm32f4xx_hal.c:112:19:HAL_Init	8	static
stm32f4xx_hal_i2c.c:1204:19:HAL_I2C_Master_Receive	48	static
stm32f4xx_hal_uart.c:2101:6:HAL_UART_IRQHandler	40	static
stm32f4xx_hal.c:322:13:HAL_IncTick	0	static
filter.c:18:7:filter	128	static
printf.c:25:1:printf	64	static
vfprintf.c:861:1:_vfprintf_r	600	static

inputs.label: Interrupts
inputs.help: Level = preemption priority; handlers on the same level cannot nest.

examples.title: STM32 superloop with printf and three interrupts
RTOS task stack, FPU on, from .su data only

input.su:
sensor.c:40:6:sensor_task	56	static
bme280.c:120:9:bme280_read	72	static
bme280.c:88:14:compensate	48	static
tasks.c:1210:6:vTaskDelay	24	static

usage: Give the architecture (cm, cmfpu, avr, riscv), the entry function, a function table {name, frame bytes (blank = from .su), calls as a space list}, optional pasted GCC .su lines, interrupts {handler, preemption level} and a margin in %. It returns the deepest path from the entry in bytes with the path itself, the nested-interrupt load, the worst case and the recommended stack size (rounded to 8, with hex), and warnings for recursion, dynamic frames and functions with no known frame (which make the estimate a lower bound).
sources: Arm Armv7-M ARM B1.5.7 exception entry stack frame (8 words, 26 with FP context) and CCR.STKALIGN
Longest-path worst-case stack analysis (as in GCC -fcallgraph-info / puncover / avstack), rule of thumb margin 20-30 %
